text: **What is printed answers, for every ID an ask can carry.** Given an open ask with an option ID of each kind above that an ask may still carry, when `deep inbox answer` runs with the ask's handle and that option as `deep inbox` printed it, then the ask is answered with that option.
**An ID an ask may not carry is refused when the ask is raised,** naming the ID and why, if the IDs are narrowed.
